items.text: For lenders · Where the risk has moved
A borrower’s revenue is its customers’ credit. We could not find anyone who publishes guidance on that.

We looked for published guidance on how a software borrower’s customer concentration or end-market exposure should be treated in underwriting: from the rating agencies, the bank regulators and the loan market’s trade association. We did not find any. If it exists, tell us and we will correct this page.
Healthcare providers’ share of August 2026 liability management transactions
The largest single group, ahead of software and IT services at 11 percent each. For healthcare software, these are the borrower’s customers.
Software loan bid at the end of August 2026, percent of par
Up from a June low of 85.65, and still 330 basis points below January’s 95.20.
Private credit deals in 2025 that capped non-recurring add-backs
Down from 47 percent in 2024 and 66 percent in 2023.
General principles that replaced the interagency guidance on leveraged lending
The OCC and the FDIC rescinded the 2013 guidance on December 5, 2025. The Federal Reserve did not join.

PitchBook LCD, September 2, 2026. A law firm’s annual private credit deal-terms study, reported February 12, 2026. OCC Bulletin 2025-44, December 5, 2025. Default rates are not quoted here: the published rates differ by up to six times on methodology.

The borrower’s customers
Concentration, retention and contract terms, and the condition of the end market the revenue depends on.
Earnings, traced
Revenue reconciled to bank deposits, and each add-back marked supported or unsupported.
What it is not
Non-attest preparation. It is not a quality of earnings report, and nothing here substitutes for work a lender is required to commission.
For lenders and financing partners
The borrower’s customers, read before the credit committee asks.

Capital Row reads a software borrower the way its customers’ market will: concentration, retention and contract terms, with earnings traced to source. Any lender-required valuation or assurance work is separately scoped and commissioned.
Talk to the desk
One business day, read by a person. Financing providers who want to be on the Capital Connections panel can say so in the same note.
